action: Maren holds the plastic receiver against her ear, waiting.
thought: The tone just keeps buzzing, flat and empty, like nobody's on the other end.

speech.text: Nobody's picking up at the depot. Should I try the clinic line?

name: Milo Adeyemi
action: Milo creases a damp towel into a sharp square.
thought: If I fold them right, maybe nobody asks me to help with the heavy lifting.

speech.text: Leave it. They're probably all stuck in the rain anyway.

name: Theo Bello
action: Theo taps the dead phone against a palm, listening to the hum.
thought: There's nothing on this line except static and people pretending they can't hear.

speech.text: Dead again. Must have knocked the wire outside in the yard.

name: Tomas Lindqvist
action: Tomas flips a page of the medical file under the desk lamp.
thought: Names keep changing on these intake forms, but the ailments stay exactly the same.

speech.text: Did you find the notes from Tuesday's intake yet?

name: Marta Petrakis
action: Marta presses a heavy thumb down on the corner of an incident report.
thought: Paperwork piles up faster than the rain fills the street drains.

speech.text: File this under the third drawer before Dr. Amin asks for it.
